card.what: Plain-top (non-self-tailing) winch, size 6: the self-tailer's turned base, bell and drum (with fine grip ribs), a black flange where the drum's top flares out to stop the line, the same glossy black sloped cap with the handle socket set down in it. Size 16 (standard two-speed) and 8 options
card.boats: J/22 cabin-top halyard winches (size 6, the size retailers list for the J/22); Catalina 22 jib sheet winches (size 16 plain-tops, the class's usual primaries)
card.before: Winch16's plain build from round 1 of this PR (a black base disc, a plain drum, a flat black top with a raised socket): 90 mm base, 82 mm tall

references.url: size 6 plain-top classic winch retailer tables (defender.com, upffront.com, westcoastsailing.net, listed for the J/22): base 90 mm, drum 60 mm, height 82 mm, line entry 33 mm
size 16 two-speed standard (plain-top) winch listings (mauripro.com, asap-supplies.com): base 120 mm, height 112 mm

references.use: the family look (base, bell, drum, cap and socket) from Bean's self-tailer photo; no plain-top photo yet
references.url: Bean's upload in the winch thread, Nov 8 2026 (measuring only)

sizes.name: Base diameter, seen from the side

features.text: Round base with a straight side, a fine plinth line and a soft shoulder; no screws showing
A concave bell from the base up into the drum
A drum with fine vertical grip ribs, flaring at its top
A black flange wider than the drum where the line stops, with moulded lettering (made-up TERNWAY)
A polished star-hole handle socket set down in a black sloped cap
No self-tailing jaws or stripper arm: plainly a plain-top
Metal base and drum, black flange and cap, stainless socket

budget.note: a small part on small boats: the J/22 carries two, the Catalina 22 two
